name: Athena OS
headline: Ask your cameras anything.
definition: Athena OS is open-source vision AI for operations teams. Show it a photo or a short video, ask a question in plain words, and get counts, marked areas and next steps. Self-hosted. Apache-2.0.
description: Athena OS is open-source vision AI for operations teams. Show it a photo, ask in plain words, get counts and next steps. Self-hosted, Apache-2.0.
features: Ask a question in plain words about a photo or short video
Ready-made checks for parking, foot traffic, corrosion, defects and safety gear
Open-source Qwen by default, or any OpenAI-compatible AI
Runs on your own server with no Athena cloud

faq.a: Athena OS is open-source vision AI for operations teams. Show it a photo or a short video and ask a question in plain words. It counts, spots and explains — then tells you what to do next.

faq.q: Do I need to write code?
faq.a: No. Pick a ready-made check like parking occupancy, or write your question the way you would ask a colleague. No data science.
On your own server. Apache-2.0. Pictures can stay on your network. There is no Athena cloud on this page.
It ships with the open Qwen vision-language model. You can also plug in any AI that speaks the OpenAI-compatible API, including OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, vLLM, Ollama and LM Studio.
